name: Tricolon (Rule of Three)
axiom: Three clauses make a pattern, a rhythm and a stop.
trigger: Speechwriting, mission statements and value definitions, where a line must be repeated out loud.

steps.text: Choose three items of the same kind.
Let the third carry the weight or the turn.

antiPattern.violation: Three items that are not the same kind, so the pattern promises a shape the list does not keep.
antiPattern.remediation: Check they are the same part of speech and the same level of abstraction. Parallel form is the whole trick.
